source: Howard et al. arXiv:1810.08240v9, Theorems 1 and 4, equation (8)
predictor: Previous cumulative success fraction, 0 initially; fixed before and throughout each predeclared batch
stop: First batch endpoint with L>0 and (U-L)/(U+L)<0.1; report 2LU/(L+U); otherwise budget exhaustion or empty intersection
stream_scope: Fixed reference diamond, fixed independent marks, known dimension and scale, fresh iid uniform positions. Adapt number of draws, not the spatial sampling law.
chain_reference_policy: Fresh independent flat-reference bank for each diagnostic query; no fitting or adaptive selection by observed height
chain_controls: Spatially compressed samples in the same flat spacetime (density confounding)
implementation_gate: One-sided binomial test for excess anytime miscoverage (4 stream cells) or excess flat-null rejection (4 chain cells), Bonferroni 0.01/8; gates are consistency checks, not proof of the theorem
integration_demo: One independent 4D local geometric stream; count-only stopping; one conditional chain diagnostic of all inner points at stopping
dependence_negative_control: 128 streams repeat one Bernoulli(0.5) outcome forever; demonstrates failure outside constant conditional mean assumptions; no theorem gate
nonclaims: No unrestricted adaptation of spatial sampling
